source_observations.observation: The source PNG has an opaque red-wrapped shaft butt near normalized (0.28,0.84), lower handhold (0.31,0.79), exposed upper wooden handhold (0.48,0.41), wood-to-head intersection (0.55,0.27), dark metal head (0.65,0.25) and visible sharp outer edge (0.73,0.28). All of these were sampled at 1600 x 1600 native pixels.

The original character holds the lower axe shaft with his anatomical right hand and a genuinely separate upper shaft region with his anatomical left hand. The metal cutting edge lies at the far end of the head, away from both grasp regions.

specifications.explanation: Reviewed on both full-resolution source images: right palm grips lower leather shaft, left palm grips exposed upper wood. The metal head and visibly sharpened blade are separate from the handholds. Body-relative orientation is provisional until actual Mixamo and independent 3D vision QA.
